summary: Driver gap; retried as attempt 002. Under RLIMIT_NOFILE = baseline 46 + 30 = 76, converting a 62-module model at the fix parent 9575f7d8b2af quantized every module, then failed in compilation: the log shows ' ## Error opening .../qtensors/model.layers.1.safetensors' and 'OSError: [Errno 24] Too many open files'. The repro's own exception handler then failed too (printing the traceback needs file descriptors), so the process exited 1 without a structured report and the harness recorded did_not_run. At the fix 4710c012a51f the same conversion completed under the same limit and wrote the output model.
